notes: Current portable transport retains full wire record and allocates max_record+1 decoded bytes.
Concurrent partial buffers in both origins plus a single synchronous decode are counted; no two simultaneous decoder calls assumed.
Excludes transport context, native receive/queue buffers, allocator metadata, graphics canvas, retained scene/assets, timers and task stack.
A smaller message limit does not shrink a 32KiB zlib dictionary.
